decisions.reason: Because audio and web conferencing builds directly on the firm's established managed voice and collaboration services, its existing knowledge lets it interpret demand and improve the offer, making withdrawal unlikely.
The positive adoption result for the Hong Kong Metro data centre connection and its closeness to existing network services indicate strong absorptive capacity, making dropping very unlikely.
Although optical spectrum extends the offer, it builds on the firm's core fibre and wavelength expertise and has its own product page, signalling commitment and ability to learn from early results.
The voice number ordering portal leverages existing voice platforms, so the firm can readily assimilate customer feedback and is unlikely to drop it.
